metadata.title: The Gorsky-Oblomkov-Rasmussen conjecture over $\mathbb{Q}$
metadata.abstract: We prove a generation theorem for the homology of certain Koszul complexes which naturally arise as the $E^1$ pages of the stable Rasmussen spectral sequence of torus links. Combining this theorem with recent work of Ballinger, Gorsky, Hogancamp, and Wang, we compute the stable Khovanov-Rozansky $\mathfrak{gl}_N$ homology of torus links and determine its Poincaré series, resolving conjectures of Gorsky, Oblomkov, and Rasmussen and their $\mathfrak{gl}_N$ analogs, over $\mathbb{Q}$. Using these results, we determine the Khovanov homology of $T(n,n-1)$ and $T(n,n)$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, confirming conjectures of Shumakovitch and Turner and of the first author, which in turn allows us to compute the Khovanov skein lasagna module of $\overline{\mathbb{CP}^2}$ over $\mathbb{Q}$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 有理系数下GOR猜想与稳定链环同调
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明相关Koszul复形同调的生成定理，结合近期结果计算环面链环稳定gl_N Khovanov–Rozansky同调及Poincaré级数。
analysis.breakthrough: 作者宣布在Q系数下解决GOR及gl_N类比猜想，并计算T(n,n−1)、T(n,n)的Khovanov同调，进一步计算反向CP²的相应lasagna模。
analysis.limitations: 系数域明确为Q，稳定极限及特定环面链环范围不可扩成整系数或任意结。AI披露语境补看第13页Remark3.3：正文给双分次向量空间同构及相伴分次代数，未直接确定原同调代数结构；n≤N+1的进一步代数同构只记为AI agent声称有证明，不能当成本文已证结论。第3页列出的AI生成Lean形式化未在本次运行核验。当前主数学解读仍依据摘要，未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第3页明确辅助族初始想法由作者提出、后主要由AI发展；AI找到并证明完成归纳所关键的恒等式(13)，进行第2.4节及附录A计算，并协助写作和编辑。因此具体归因的关键恒等式/归纳路线记ideas、proofs，另记computation、writing。作者核验并大幅简化证明。该页另称有AI生成的定理1.2/A.1/A.4 Lean 4形式化，本次未运行或独立检验。第13页Remark3.3仅说AI agent声称n≤N+1时有进一步代数同构证明，不能当作本文已证明或社区确认的结论。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10885v1 · PDF 第3页 AI disclosure/Lean formalization；第13页 Remark3.3
